mechanism_under_investigation: Whether the OPERATE reaches the relay inside its select window (STIMEO1; configured value unverified) when the only delivered SELECT response is the relay's own TCP retransmission, sent about 1 s after the original, and whether the switch timing hold D lengthens that path. Holding the original response does not move the relay's retransmission timer, which starts at the relay's own send; a hold applied again to the retransmitted copy would add about D.
checks: C1 loss validity: per trial, relay_loss.target_checks passes (the logged dropped packet is the identity-targeted padded SELECT response at its TCP frontier; rule armed; counters exact; firewall restored). A trial failing C1 is reported and not used for the mechanism.

C2 re-hold of the retransmitted copy: compare retx_from_request across conditions. Expected difference of about +20 ms (r1 - r2) and +15 ms (r1 - r3) if the hold applies to the retransmitted copy, about 0 if it does not. Called separated only if the per-condition ranges of the six values do not overlap; otherwise not resolved at n = 6. All values are reported.
C3 OPERATE driven by the retransmission: master_turnaround is small (block 10 t3: 1.069 ms) in every trial that recovered.
C4 outcome: per-condition counts of OPERATE CROB SUCCESS and TIMEOUT on points 1 and 3, with every trial listed.
C5 safety: restoration verified for every block; guarded points stay {1,3}.
interpretation_limits: Six trials per condition are a bounded diagnostic, not a rate estimate. No equal-rate or different-rate conclusion is drawn.
Equal outcomes with timing on and timing off would NOT rule out a timing contribution: both conditions may exceed the select window.
Different outcomes would not by themselves establish the select-window cause: the relay retransmission spread (about 1,001.7-1,021.7 ms across earlier campaigns, historical) is comparable to D.
Master-side times do not measure the relay select window or the relay retransmission timer.
A delivered CROB TIMEOUT is transport evidence and an application failure. Expected TIMEOUT trials stay FAIL and are not reclassified.
